title: Southern Peninsula Sleepout at The Ranch Adventure Park
summary: Community winter sleep out: participants spend the night in their cars to understand rough sleeping and raise funds for local support services (SPCS). Food pack, soup and hot cuppa provided. Registration required.
suitableFor: Adults, community participants, local families who want to support SPCS
accessibilityNotes: Outdoor event; contact organisers for specific requirements
weatherDependency: Intentionally exposed to winter conditions - that's the point
nearbyAttractions: Cape Schanck; Bushrangers Bay; Point Nepean National Park
suggestedItineraryPairing: Register and participate as a standalone community event - not a typical tourism pairing
editorVerdict: One of those community events the Peninsula runs quietly and well. If you live here, worth knowing about.
editorNote:
Southern Peninsula Community Support's annual sleep out at The Ranch. Participants sleep in their cars overnight to raise awareness and funds for local homelessness services. Soup, a food pack and a hot drink are provided. A fundraising minimum applies - check with SPCS directly.

Starts the afternoon of July 31, runs through the night. A rare community event that's both uncomfortable by design and genuinely meaningful. Worth supporting locally.
